description: Wnode Node Operator local reputation score schema
scoring_range: 0.0 to 1.0 per dimension, total is weighted average

uptime_score.description: Ratio of actual uptime to expected uptime since registration

task_success_score.description: Ratio of successfully completed tasks to total assigned tasks

heartbeat_score.description: Ratio of on-time heartbeats to expected heartbeats

thermal_score.description: Penalty applied when thermal throttling is detected

battery_score.description: Penalty applied when battery is low or not charging

total_score.description: Weighted composite score across all dimensions
